notes: 【命名纠偏】NUS 不存在名为『MSc in Artificial Intelligence』的官方项目。School of Computing 的官方名称是 Master of Computing in Artificial Intelligence (MComp in AI)，属 MComp 学位而非 MSc；comp.nus.edu.sg/graduate/ 硕士清单中无 MSc in AI。

【停办/改名】旧 Master of Computing (Artificial Intelligence Specialisation) 已停办，官网标注『Last Intake: January 2025 (AY2024/2025, Semester 2)』，由独立学位 Master of Computing in Artificial Intelligence 取代；现行 Annex A 标注『Applies to August 2025 Intake onwards』。
【入学季】自 AY2025 起每年仅一次入学（8 月），1 月入学取消；官网原文『Effective from AY2025, there will only be one intake (August intake) in each year.』

【官网口径冲突】MSBA 名称不一致：NUS Bulletin AY2026/27 的 Degrees Offered 写『Master of Business Analytics (jointly with the NUS School of Business)』，而 MSBA 项目官网、NUS Business School 官网及 Bulletin 正文均写『Master of Science in Business Analytics (MSBA)』；以项目官网为准。

【学院归属纠偏】Master of Science in Data Science and Machine Learning (DSML) 属 Faculty of Science 的 Department of Mathematics 主办（与 Department of Statistics and Data Science、School of Computing 的 Department of Computer Science 合作），不在 School of Computing 名下。

【学费入学季标签，禁止混用】MComp (with Specialisations) 与 MComp in AI 为 S$67,144（含 9% GST，官网标注 AY2026/2027 (August 2026 Intake) onwards）；MComp (General Track) 与 MSc DFinTech 为 S$76,409（含 9% GST，官网标注 AY2027/2028 (August 2027 Intake) onwards）；NUS MSBA 为 S$87,550（含 9% GST，AY2027/28）；DSML 为 SGD 58,860（含 9% GST，August 2027 Intake 官方海报）。

【MSBA 文书与语言】NUS MSBA 有指定申请文书题（≤350 词，可用 3 分钟视频且『A video is highly preferred』），且 AY2027/28 官方申请指南明确『You do not need to submit an English language test such as IELTS or TOEFL』；与 School of Computing 项目要求 GRE/GMAT + TOEFL/IELTS 不同。

【第三方信息禁止入库为事实】新东方前途出国、国际教育联盟等第三方声称的『NUS MSc in Artificial Intelligence』『IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL 100』『与 Google 深度合作 / Willow 量子处理器 / 3-6 个月企业实习 / 毕业生进入谷歌微软比例数据』『MComp 2027 学费 69,215 新元』『DFinTech 要求 GMAT 700』等，均无 nus.edu.sg 官方依据或与官网冲突，不得写入事实字段。
【资料版本】本次核实到的最新 NUS Bulletin 为 AY2026/27；AY2027/28 的申请窗口与学费由各学院项目官网单独发布，结构/课程信息以 AY2026/27 Bulletin 与学院官网项目页及官方 Annex PDF 为准。
【易混淆项目】Faculty of Science 另有 MSc in AI for Science（列于 science.nus.edu.sg MSc by coursework 清单），是与 MComp in AI 不同的项目，勿混淆。
【TOEFL 量表】School of Computing 各 admissions 页 TOEFL 原文均为『90 or 4.5』且未解释 4.5；Faculty of Science 页面明确 4.5 为 2026-01-21 起新版 TOEFL 量表、85/90 为旧版 iBT 口径，但 SoC 页未确认该类比，故相关字段标注待核实。
【DSML 申请材料】官网清单列 Resume/CV、成绩单、语言成绩、财力证明（最低 SGD 30,000）、奖学金/获奖/专业证书，未列 Personal Statement 与推荐信；不得虚构 PS 要求。

programs.english: TOEFL iBT 90（官网原文『90 or 4.5』，4.5 含义官网未解释，待核实）；IELTS 6.0。仅『Applicants who graduated from Universities where English is not the main medium of instruction』必须提交。GRE/GMAT 5 年有效、TOEFL/IELTS 2 年有效

admission.background: 官网：『A bachelor's degree in computing; or A bachelor's degree in a related discipline (such as Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM), Finance, Economics, Statistics or Business)』；『Candidates with academic qualifications other than the above may be considered for admission on a case-by-case basis』
admission.prerequisites: 官网：『Since a large proportion of our curriculum involves programming, non-computing students must provide sufficient evidence of python programming knowledge and/or evidence of learning advanced quantitative subjects』
admission.gre_gmat: 最低 GRE 320 (verbal & quantitative) + 3.5 (analytical) 或 GMAT 650 及以上；印度院校毕业生可用 GATE 替代；官网『Applicants are to submit GRE/GMAT and TOEFL/IELTS test scores as evidence demonstrating their readiness for graduate study』
admission.work_experience: 明确不要求：官网『Work experiences in FinTech, AI, or Data Analytics will be advantageous, but are not required』

curriculum.structure: 官网明确『The MSc DFinTech is a master's degree by coursework programme』：7 门 core（28 Units，其中从 11 门 FT50xx 中任选 3 门 12 Units + 4 门必修 16 Units）+ 3 门 elective（12 Units）+ 12 Units capstone（FT5007 或 3 门选修替代），共 52 Units；官方 Annex A 标注『Applicable to August 2026 Intake onwards』
core: FT5001 Fintech Innovations: A Strategic Landscape
BMD5301 Introduction to Finance for FinTech Professionals
BMD5302 Financial Modelling for FinTech Professionals
electives: FT5009 Contemporary Topics in Financial Data Analytics
FT5010 Algorithmic Trading Systems Design and Deployment
tracks: Digital Financial Transactions and Risk Management

highlights: 官网：『this graduate programme in FinTech is designed to help students build a strong foundation in computing and finance』，选修按三条 tracks 组织

官网 Programme Vision Statement：『To be the world's leading Master of Science in Digital Finance and AI, developing future leaders with entrepreneurial and inclusive mindsets, supported by a powerful alumni network and industry partners ... anchoring Singapore as a trusted financial hub for the world』
官网：设 Programme Industry Advisory Committee（成员来自 Monetary Authority of Singapore、DBS、Ant International、Trust Bank Singapore、Stripe、Circle、Warwick Business School 等）
官网：Capstone『Students can choose either an academic research project under the supervision of world-class scholars at NUS, or a FinTech internship』；毕业最低 GPA 3.0
career: 官网：『careers as AI software developers, data scientists, FinTech security specialists, financial quantitative analysts and other similar professions』
官网：『in financial institutions or FinTech firms』
官网 Programme Industry Advisory Committee 成员来自 Monetary Authority of Singapore、DBS、Ant International、Trust Bank Singapore、Stripe、Circle 等（为顾问委员会构成，非就业去向数据）
具体就业率 / 薪资 待核实
writing_hooks: 呼应官网『build a strong foundation in computing and finance』与三条 tracks（Computing Technologies / Financial Data Analytics and Intelligence / Digital Financial Transactions and Risk Management）：文书须说明 computing 与 finance 双背景的交汇点及目标 track。
官网『non-computing students must provide sufficient evidence of python programming knowledge and/or evidence of learning advanced quantitative subjects』：非计算机背景申请者必须具体举证 Python 能力与高等量化课程。
官网职业表述『careers as AI software developers, data scientists, FinTech security specialists, financial quantitative analysts ... in financial institutions or FinTech firms』：未来职业规划段落应对齐这些岗位与机构类型。

Personal Statement 官网原文『reasons for applying to the programme, your preparation for the field of study, future career plans』；并注意官网『Work experiences in FinTech, AI, or Data Analytics will be advantageous, but are not required』——有相关经历则突出，无则不必虚构。

conflicts: 名称写法不一致：NUS Bulletin AY2026/27 写『Master of Science - Digital Financial Technology (MSc DFinTech)』，学院项目页写『Master of Science in Digital Financial Technology (MSc DFinTech)』，页面标题另作『Master of Science in Digital FinTech』；缩写 MSc DFinTech 一致。
申请表 mdft/application 仅写『August intake』未写年份，而费用页明确 AY2027/2028 (August 2027 Intake) onwards；本报告将申请窗口对应到 2027 年 8 月入学并标注为推断。
历史归属表述：aidf.nus.edu.sg 的 2021/2022 版 Annex 曾称该课程由 Asian Institute of Digital Finance 管理，现行 School of Computing 官网未再如此表述；以现行 SoC 官网为准。
第三方（新东方）称 DFinTech 要求 GMAT 700、学费 64,800/70,632 新元，与官网 GMAT 650 及 S$76,409 冲突，不采信。
